text:
alex: Kicking off region bring-up for eu-central-2. Need cloud account + project + VNet scaffold runbook. Who can own the network pieces? cc @sue @chandra

sue: I can lead network + shared VPC setup. Preference is to create a host project (redwood-host-euc2) and attach service projects. Need org-admin to create project and enable Shared VPC.

chandra: +1 on host project. Also note: eu-central-2 currently lacks A100 in some zones — we'll need to request GPU quota or plan fallback (A10/GV100). I can take GPU quota requests.

kevin: A few quick constraints to record:
- NAT for private nodes (cloud NAT or HA-NAT)
- internal DNS + keep-alive for KV cache endpoints
- route table with no 0.0.0.0/0 on node pools (egress via NAT)
- VPC peering for metrics/logs to central observability project (avoid cross-region egress for hot paths)

alex: Good. Can someone paste the baseline commands we run for project creation + APIs? I'll include in the runbook.

sue: Here's the minimal commands I use (gcloud):
```
# create project and link billing
gcloud projects create redwood-euc2-host --name="Redwood EU-Central-2 Host"
gcloud beta billing projects link redwood-euc2-host --billing-account=0123-4567-89AB
# enable apis
gcloud services enable compute.googleapis.com iam.googleapis.com servicenetworking.googleapis.com
# enable shared vpc
gcloud compute shared-vpc enable redwood-euc2-host
```
Add IAM: give `roles/compute.networkAdmin` to infra service account and `roles/resourcemanager.projectIamAdmin` to cloudops.

chandra: GPU check commands:
```
# list accelerator types in region
gcloud compute accelerator-types list --filter="zone:(eu-central2-*)"
# check quota for NVIDIAs
gcloud compute regions describe eu-central2 --format="yaml(quota)"
```
If A100 not available, open support ticket with this template: "Request GPU quota for project redwood-euc2-<env>: accelerator NVIDA A10 or fallback A100, region eu-central-2, desired total vCPUs and accelerators." I'll file and link ticket id.

kevin: For networking specifics:
- VPC subnet plan: use /20 per availability zone, keep private subnets only for nodes, public subnets for bastion + NATs.
- Route table: ensure routes to peered observability VPC and to on-prem via VPN.
- Firewall baseline: allow intra-VPC 10.0.0.0/8, allow SSH from bastion only, allow healthchecks from LB ranges.
- Add a Flow Logs sink to central logging project for 30d retention in this region.

alex: Ops checklist draft (what I want validated before handoff):
1) Project created + billing export wired to billing project
2) Host project shared VPC enabled + service projects attached
3) Subnets created per AZ with tags and route tables
4) Cloud NAT / HA-NAT configured for private nodes
5) Firewall baseline applied and validated (ping/ssh via bastion)
6) GPU quota in place or documented fallback plan + ticket id
7) Private GKE/GKE-on-VM nodepool tested with one GPU node and nvml visible
8) Monitoring/Alerting: node exporter + nvidia-smi metrics, cluster logs forwarding to central observability
9) Tagging / labels added for cost center and env; billing export + BigQuery dataset ready
10) Runbook PR + terraform module ready for handoff

infra-bot: [system] created runbook PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/402 (auto-draft).

chandra: Validation steps I'll run once quota + project are ready:
- `gcloud compute instances create gpu-test --accelerator=type=nvidia-a10,count=1 --zone=eu-central2-a --machine-type=n1-highmem-16`
- SSH and `nvidia-smi` to ensure drivers visible
- Run a quick 1-thread inference container to validate CUDA + model pull (lightweight toy model)
- Check node metrics: /metrics shows `nvidia_duty_cycle` and `gpu_memory_total`

sue: Terraform module notes (snippet for shared VPC attach):
```hcl
resource "google_compute_shared_vpc_host_project" "host" {
  project = "redwood-euc2-host"
}
resource "google_project" "service_project" {
  name       = "redwood-euc2-prod"
  project_id = "redwood-euc2-prod"
  org_id     = "1234567890"
}
resource "google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project" "attach" {
  host_project    = google_compute_shared_vpc_host_project.host.project
  service_project = google_project.service_project.project_id
}
```
Make sure the service account that runs Terraform has `roles/resourcemanager.projectIamAdmin` to attach.

alex: Cost note: estimate extra ~0.08-0.12 $/GB egress if we cross regions for model loads; prefer colocating model weights. Also reservation vs spot: recommend 60% reserved for steady batch and 40% preemptible for spiky jobs. Put cost-center labels to enforce budget.

kevin: Security: add org policy to restrict external IP assignment on compute instances except for bastion; require shielded VM for nodes.

alex: Great — @sue please open the PR for terraform + runbook, @chandra please file the GPU quota ticket and paste the id here, @kevin can you add org policy snippet to the repo? I'll do a final validation once all items are green.

sue: Will do. PR target tomorrow EOD.

chandra: Filed quota request: ticket #INC-83421. Requested A10 x16 for prod pool and A100 x8 if availability appears. Will update when approved.

kevin: I'll draft the org policy and push a branch.

alex: Thanks team — once PRs are merged I'll run the validation checklist and schedule handoff sync with product infra. :white_check_mark:
